# Cncf Falkordb Reviewer

Review FalkorDB using its official documentation and repository in the AI Agent / Knowledge Graph category. A super fast Graph Database uses GraphBLAS under the hood for its sparse adjacency matrix graph representation. Our goal is to provide the best Knowledge Graph for LLM (GraphRAG).

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
